one_month_reasoning: One major scheduled event falls in the window: 3Q26 earnings on Oct 28, 2026 (Laguna transcript; consensus calendars). Two smaller ones: the record date for the $0.50 dividend (Oct 27) and the hyperscaler Q3 capex prints in late October. At Laguna (Sept 16) the CEO pre-announced a 'very strong' 3Q order quarter. Customers are converting slot reservations into orders faster, and the $200B backlog should be reached 'very early' in 2027. So a strong orders headline is largely expected. He also flagged that Electrification data-center orders will fall to about 20% of segment orders in 3Q/4Q, down from about 40% in 1H, and that most of the 12 GW of new 2030-31 capacity will be contracted in 4Q rather than 3Q. Either could disappoint people reading headlines. Q2 missed adjusted EPS by about 19% ($2.47 vs $3.04) and the stock slipped even though guidance was raised (Investing.com transcript), so near-term EPS execution is a live risk. Consensus Q3 EPS is about $4.07-4.15 on about $12.0B revenue. The stock bounced 3.9% on Oct 1 (to $987) after Evercore raised estimates, which recovers part of the late-Sept drawdown from the AI-slowdown essay and the Oracle force majeure. Hyperscaler capex guidance has been raised or held across the board (Supercycle HQ), which supports the setup. The Fed hike, a 19-year-high 10-year yield and oil above $100 weigh on multiples. Net, I see no edge on direction. I use a near-symmetric lognormal with median ~$990 and monthly sigma ~15.5% (52%/3.5 plus a little extra for the earnings day), so P(>= spot) is about 50%.

fair_value.method: Blend of P/E on Oct-2027 NTM EPS (~$30.0 x 34x = $1,020), 2028 FCF yield (~$35/sh normalized FCF at 3.6% + ~$35/sh net cash = $1,007) and 2028 EV/EBITDA ($11.2B x 22x + ~$12B net cash, over 260M shares = $993). Weights 45/25/30 give about $1,009.

inputs_detail.derivation: Consensus sources disagree: $24.85 (26 analysts, Erste/DefenseWorld) and $24.91 (WallStreetZen), while one aggregator reports $22.21. Q2's 19% EPS miss [23] and Erste's cuts argue for the low end, so I use $24.0.

WallStreetZen 2028 consensus is $34.80 and another aggregator shows $30.52. My bottom-up from the 2028 target ($56B revenue x 20% = $11.2B EBITDA, less ~$1.2B D&A, plus ~$0.3B interest, 20% tax, ~260M shares) gives ~$31.5. I use $32.0, slightly above my bottom-up, because CEO comments show margin in backlog rising (Power 2026 change > low double digits) [17].

Stock is ~41x 2027 consensus today. By late 2027 EPS growth slows toward high-teens, so I compress the multiple. I cut it 1 turn versus my round-1 35x because the Fed restarted hikes (3.75-4.00%) with long yields at multi-decade highs [19]. Bull anchor: Zaccardi ~40x on normalized EPS [6]. Bear anchor: GLJ $470 (~17x) [5].

bear.story: AI-capex digestion: political and regulatory friction (the Sept-14 AI-lab slowdown essay, state data-center moratoria, the Oracle/Stargate force majeure) delays data-center power projects. Many of the 63 GW of slot reservations lapse instead of converting. Siemens and Mitsubishi capacity additions, plus GLJ's 2030-31 overcapacity math, cap pricing. A Fed tightening cycle and a recession (Polymarket 35% by end-2027) hit utility capex and multiples. 2028 EPS falls toward ~$25-26 and the multiple to ~23x NTM.

base.story: Backlog passes $200B in early 2027, reservations keep converting (10 GW in 2Q26 alone), output ramps from 5 to 6 GW a quarter in 2H27, and Power margin in backlog keeps expanding. Electrification grows despite lumpy data-center orders, and Wind losses narrow in 2027. 2028 EPS of ~$31-32 is visible, but the multiple compresses from ~41x to ~34x NTM in a higher-rate world, so the stock gains only modestly.

bull.story: Hyperscaler capex heads to $1.3-1.4T in 2027 with nobody cutting. 2032 slots sell at premium pricing, and the January call shows a larger change in margin in backlog. The 2028 targets are raised again (Prolec ahead of plan, services annuity story), and the market keeps ~42x+ on ~$34 NTM EPS (top of target range $1,450).

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$650 (about -34%, near the lower part of the 52-week range), the market would be pricing ~21x on ~$31 2028 EPS or a cut to the 2028 targets. That most likely means slot reservations are being cancelled or left unconverted (watch the 53 GW firm vs 63 GW reservation split), gas turbine pricing on new slots has turned, or hyperscaler capex has actually been cut. Ordinary multiple volatility would not take it that low. Management buying back stock at an average $560 marks where it sees deep value.

reasoning: Facts: GEV at $987 trades ~65x 2026 EPS ($15.17 consensus) and ~40x 2027 consensus (~$24), with ~$9.4B net cash. FY26 FCF guidance of $11.5-12.5B is inflated by deposits. 2Q26 orders rose 88% organically, but EPS missed by 19%. The 2028 outlook ($56B revenue, 20% EBITDA margin) is now verified in the 4Q25 release and implies ~$31-32 EPS, near consensus ($30.5-34.8). Continuation research (budget restored, ~25 more queries/reads) changed the evidence in both directions. Bull: (1) The Laguna transcript (9/16): 2032 slots are selling with cash committed, 12 GW of new 2030-31 supply all in contracting at premium pricing, customers are accelerating reservation-to-order conversion, $200B backlog very early in 2027, and Power margin-in-backlog expansion in 2026 above 2025's low double digits. (2) The Supercycle HQ capex roundup: every hyperscaler raised or held 2026 guidance, and S&P sees ~$1.3T of 2027 capex. Bear: (1) ElectronEconomics: only 53 GW of the 116 GW is firm; the other 63 GW are paid options. (2) GLJ's 2030-31 overcapacity math. (3) Data-center Electrification orders will slow to ~20% of segment orders in 2H. (4) Macro has turned: the Fed hiked to 3.75-4.00% on 9/16 with another hike signalled, oil is above $100 and long yields are at multi-decade highs, which argues for lower multiples. (5) A Polymarket market on an AI data-center moratorium before 2027 has resolved (~$91k volume), showing the political friction is real. Job postings in Greenville (~91-100) are steady versus July (93), which fits execution, not a further step-up. The new evidence lifts my 2028 EPS slightly but lowers the multiples, so the blended fair value slips from $1,026 to ~$1,009, about 2% above spot. Scenario mean: 0.25x600 + 0.5x1050 + 0.25x1450 = $1,038. Ladder: lognormal with median ~$1,005 and sigma ~0.46 (below the 52% realized vol, part of which came from the AI-rerating spike), with a slightly fatter left tail for reservation, AI-politics and rate risk. P(>= spot) is about 51.5%. Limits: Reddit and X were not fetchable (blocked), and Glassdoor/Simply Wall St/CNBC returned 403, so social signal still comes via secondary coverage. Alpha Vantage estimates hit its rate limit.
